title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he's in therapy | TechCrunch
summary: Huang held Nvidia’s first all-hands meeting on Tuesday since his reinstatement on Monday. The CEO admitted in the meeting that he had flouted Nvidia’s code of conduct , which he himself had largely devised.
